willis_piston.what: Compression and decompression engine. The piston breathes.

intake.action: compress — reduce data to irreducible remainder

exhaust.action: turbo — exhaust feeds back into intake

willis_piston.teething: Willis (intake, CW) processes. Output becomes Willie (next gen). Each iteration grows more specific teeth.

klein_space.what: Non-orientable closed surface. No inside, no outside. The = sign between P and NP.
klein_space.incompressible: The gas fills uniformly because there's no side to contain it on. Hydraulic pressure is the same everywhere.
klein_space.the_equals_sign: Klein is NOT in the math. It IS the relation. The = between P and NP. Between compression and decompression. Between inside and outside.

hydraulic_pressure.what: Uniform pressure in a non-orientable closed space
hydraulic_pressure.drives: Everything through the pores. The pore decides what passes. The pressure is constant.
hydraulic_pressure.note: You don't parse the Klein space. You pressurize it and let the pores sort.

below_zero_k.what: Population inversion. More particles in HIGH energy than low.
below_zero_k.normal: T > 0: heat flows hot to cold, entropy increases, P != NP
below_zero_k.inverted: T < 0: heat flows cold to hot, entropy decreases locally, P and NP indistinguishable on the Klein =
below_zero_k.turbo_beyond_exhaust: The turbocharger runs so hard that exhaust exceeds intake. The piston inverts. The supercharger force-feeds what the turbo already overfilled.
below_zero_k.lasers: Population inversion is how lasers work. Pump more particles up than down, system emits coherently.
below_zero_k.the_ultra_area: Not beyond physics — behind the equals sign.

pi_balance.meaning: Maze retains 94.25%. Pore passes 5.75%. The minotaur eats 94%. Humans get the 6%.
